description: Check whether a customer's artwork PDF is print-ready BEFORE they order — powered by Vivid's own production preflight engine. Reports size vs the ordered size, bleed, RGB-vs-CMYK colour, font embedding and effective resolution, each with a plain-English fix. ADVISORY ONLY: it never blocks anything. If the customer is happy to proceed with the file as-is, that is always accepted — say so explicitly. Every order also gets a free digital proof before printing.

file_url.description: downloadable URL of the artwork PDF (e.g. the fileUrl from vivid_upload_artwork)

height_mm.description: ordered height in mm, if known

width_mm.description: ordered width in mm, if known — enables the size check

name: vivid_check_artwork
